readme_head:
# betting-model-starter

A template for building a sports betting model in Python on top of the
[ParlayAPI](https://parlay-api.com) odds API. Clone it (or hit "Use this
template" on GitHub), run the notebooks, and you have a working pipeline:
fetch odds and props across 30+ sportsbooks and sources, devig them into fair
probabilities, scan for edges, and backtest against historical closing lines.

Built by the ParlayAPI team. MIT licensed.

## What's inside

| File | What it does | Run it |
|---|---|---|
| `01-fetch-odds.ipynb` | Fetch game lines and player props, line-shop best prices, devig with the SDK. Runs with **no API key** against the free sandbox. | [![Open in Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/JacobiusMakes/betting-model-starter/blob/main/01-fetch-odds.ipynb) |
| `02-backtest-clv.ipynb` | Closing line value backtest against the historical closing-odds endpoints. Runs without a key on a labeled synthetic sample; pulls real closing lines when `PARLAYAPI_KEY` is set. | [![Open in Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/assets/colab-badge.svg)](https://colab.research.google.com/github/JacobiusMakes/betting-model-starter/blob/main/02-backtest-clv.ipynb) |
| `model.py` | Starter module: sandbox fetchers, line shopping, edge scanning vs a sharp baseline, quarter-Kelly staking, and CLV helpers, all built on the devig math inside the `parlay-api` SDK. | `python model.py` |

## Quickstart

```bash
git clone https://github.com/JacobiusMakes/betting-model-starter
cd betting-model-starter
pip install -r requirements.txt   # or: uv pip install -r requirements.txt
python model.py                    # keyless demo against the sandbox
jupyter lab                        # then open 01-fetch-odds.ipynb
```

No account is needed to start: everything in notebook 01 and `model.py` runs
against the keyless `/v1/sandbox/*` endpoints, which serve realistically
shaped fake data and cost nothing.

## Getting real data

- **Free tier: 1,000 credits/month, no card required.** Sign up at
  [parlay-api.com](https://parlay-api.com) and set the key as the
  `PARLAYAPI_KEY` environment variable (or a Colab secret with that name).
- Live coverage: 30+ sportsbooks and sources, 90+ sports, 4,000+ prop market
  keys in any 24 hours, sub-5-second freshness on the majors.
- Historical archive behind the closing-odds endpoints: 1.7M+ game closing
  lines back to 2005 and 30M+ player prop closing lines since 2022. Free keys
  see the most recent 48 hours; depth scales with tier, see
  [parlay-api.com/pricing](https://parlay-api.com/pricing).
- Building an agent instead? Agents can self-register via
  `POST /v1/agent/signup`, read the agent spec at
  [/openapi-agent.json](https://parlay-api.com/openapi-agent.json), or use the
  MCP server: `pip install parlayapi-mcp`.

## Honest expectations

Read this before you wire a model to a bankroll:

- **Most betting models lose.** The closing line on major sports is brutally
  efficient, the vig means you need about 52.4% against -110 just to break
  even, and books limit winners.
- **Short-term profit is noise.** A few hundred bets cannot statistically
  separate a winning bettor from a losing one. Judging a model by a
  month of PnL is how bankrolls die.
